topic: Context: system-spec-kit is a spec-authoring skill plus its command surface and the root governance layer that constrains it. Ground every claim only in: .opencode/skills/system-spec-kit/** (SKILL.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, README.md, templates, references, feature-catalog, manual-testing-playbook, runtime/cli, runtime/lib, runtime/hooks, shared), .opencode/commands/speckit/**, root AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, REPO RULES.md, repo-rules/*.md, and the restraint ladder in .opencode/skills/sk-code/shared/references/universal/code-quality-standards.md. Nothing outside these paths is evidence.

focus: Validator rule inventory (KQ1): the 39-rule registry — what exists, what fires, what duplicates
noveltyJustification: First evidence iteration: the 39-row registry, its 32/5/2 severity mix, the 5:1 CANONICAL_SAVE multiplex, the already-drifted 2-of-3 category display loop, and the dual TS/bash execution machinery were all unrecorded before this run.
keyQuestions: KQ1: Which of the validator rules (reported as 39) exist, and which fire on real packets vs never fire?
answeredQuestions: KQ1 (partial: inventory complete; strict-only firing analysis carried to the command-surface pass)

ruledOut.approach: Read all 39 rule scripts in one pass
ruledOut.reason: Read-budget discipline: rule bodies belong to the duplication pass where only their guard surfaces matter

focus: Duplication pass (KQ2): which of the 39 rules fire on real packets, which never do, which duplicate another
noveltyJustification: New: the 22/39 conditioned-row census, the 10→2 implementation collapse (two 5:1 multiplexes), the triple-tracked severity vocabulary, and the skip-variant zero-usage fact — none recorded in run 1.
keyQuestions: KQ2: Which validator-side capability flags, freshness checks, and rule pairs duplicate each other or guard nothing?
answeredQuestions: KQ2 (partial: firing/duplication census done at registry level; corpus-level firing deferred to runs 8-9)

keyQuestions: KQ3: How much of the six-runtime hook matrix is parity scaffolding for unused runtimes?

noveltyJustification: New: the 83,372-line corpus decomposed (runtime 30.6k, playbook 11.8k, references 12.9k, changelog 9.8k), the 30%-selected-by-no-intent mass (25,107 lines: changelog+benchmark+playbook), the 5-site severity-vocabulary ownership with its demonstrated display drift, and the routing covenant's 2-artifact tax per docs edit — none recorded in runs 1-3.
keyQuestions: KQ4: What documentation volume exceeds what an agent must actually read, and which docs restate each other?
answeredQuestions: KQ4 (partial: the volume decomposition and the 5-site vocabulary census done; playbook-vs-vitest restatement deferred to run 9)

focus: /speckit:* command surface (KQ5): dead steps post memory-decommission; the 14-asset reference census; phantom dashboard promises
noveltyJustification: New: the 14/14 asset-reference census (no orphans — hypothesis corrected), the 6-promised-vs-0-in-workflow dashboard gap with 3 provably mechanismless names, and the 3-doc-class retired-memory covenant whose recovery ritual guards a prevented case — none recorded in runs 1-4.
keyQuestions: KQ5: Which /speckit:* command YAML workflows and assets carry dead steps post memory-decommission?
answeredQuestions: KQ5 (answered for the covenant: enforced end-to-end; the residue is phantom dashboards and a non-resolving naming convention, not dead memory steps)

focus: Root governance (KQ6): AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md dual-maintenance; spec-kit procedure that a repo rule or the skill could own instead
noveltyJustification: New: the governance pair is ONE file (CLAUDE.md is a symlink — the 506-line duplication hypothesis is ruled out), the 9 rule files (1,615 LOC) carry exactly 1 spec-kit machinery mention, and the freshness covenant is the only 2-layer full restatement — none recorded in runs 1-5.
keyQuestions: KQ6: Which spec-kit procedure in root AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md could a repo rule (repo-rules/*.md) or the skill itself own instead?
answeredQuestions: KQ6 (answered: nothing to fold — governance=procedure, rules=behavior, skill=mechanics; 1 P2 = the freshness covenant's 2-layer restatement; 3 hypotheses ruled out at evidence level)

9 rule files, 1,615 LOC, exactly 1 spec-kit machinery mention (scope-discipline.md) — the rules own behavior only
